== Patch 1.2.12 ==
* Cloudstrike Panther has been increased to 11.5 m/s.
* Crimson Lightning has been increased to 11.5 m/s.
* The spawn rate of Flowers for the Veroe Harvest Festival has been reduced, as their over-abundance was not required.
* The Teleport Masters of the Veroe Harvest Festival have been made immovable.
* The Sushi Chefs Event has been rescheduled. It will still take place on the same days (Monday, Wednesday, Sunday) but will now happen at 2:30 PM and 10:00 PM server time. (The second timer is moved later by an hour and a half)
* The banner for the Crystalline Bloodbath will trigger more reliably
* The Rum Runner Rapids Festival has started! It will run from July 3rd 2024 until July 17th 2024 and end with maintenance.
* The Daily Event Quests will be available at 1:00 PM, 7:00 PM, and midnight (server time)
